candidates.summary: Ukrainian, Russian and US delegations concluded more than four hours of talks in Abu Dhabi on November 10, according to a spokesperson for Ukrainian delegation leader Rustem Umerov. President Volodymyr Zelensky said the discussions covered possible humanitarian measures, de-escalation and security guarantees for Ukraine. Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner led the US delegation, and Vladimir Medinsky led Russia's. No agreement was announced in the reporting checked.
candidates.title: Ukraine, Russia and US conclude first day of Abu Dhabi talks
candidates.geography: United Arab Emirates; Ukraine; Russia; United States

candidates.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics released October inflation data on November 10 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern. The Consumer Price Index rose 0.4% month over month on a seasonally adjusted basis, after September's 0.6% increase. Prices excluding food and energy rose 0.3%. Shelter increased 0.3%, food 0.5% and energy 0.7%. BLS could not publish most year-over-year comparisons because the October 2025 government shutdown prevented collection of the necessary survey data.
candidates.title: US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October

candidates.summary: Foreign Minister Anita Anand announced on November 10 that Canada was reimposing sanctions against 11 Iranian entities under its Special Economic Measures (Iran) Regulations. Global Affairs Canada attributed the measures to contributions to Iran's proliferation-sensitive nuclear activities, ballistic missile program or related financing. The entities had been delisted in 2016 following implementation of the Iran nuclear agreement. The announcement coincided with the G7 foreign ministers' meeting in Paris.
candidates.title: Canada announces renewed sanctions against 11 Iranian entities

candidates.summary: Speaking after G7 meetings in Paris on November 10, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said US sanctions and the naval blockade were exerting sufficient economic pressure on Iran that major combat operations were unnecessary. This was Rubio's assessment, not an independently established outcome. His remarks followed President Donald Trump's November 9 statement that he would hold off on additional strikes after appeals from regional governments.
candidates.title: Rubio says economic pressure on Iran removes need for major combat operations

candidates.summary: Israeli strikes and gunfire killed five people in Gaza on November 10, according to hospital authorities. Shifa Hospital reported four deaths in three strikes in Gaza City. Nasser Hospital said one person was shot dead after crossing the Yellow Line near Khan Younis. Israel's military said it struck militants in Gaza City but did not immediately comment on the Khan Younis shooting.
candidates.title: Gaza hospitals report five killed by Israeli strikes and gunfire

candidates.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth rejected the impeachment effort against him at a Pentagon news conference on November 10, arguing that the allegations concerned policy disagreements rather than impeachable offenses. Representative Thomas Massie had launched the effort on November 9 over Hegseth's handling of the Iran war and other actions. Hegseth's response was a new development; the impeachment initiative itself began the preceding day.
candidates.title: Hegseth rejects impeachment allegations at Pentagon briefing
